About the Community

blocks.text: The Heights — Family Townhomes in the Heart of Grandview Surrey

parts.t: The Heights

is a Lakewood community at 28th Avenue and 156th Street in Grandview Surrey, made up of 39 townhomes at 2845 156th Street and 66 condos at 2855 156th Street. The Shops at Morgan Crossing are about 0.7 km away.

The townhomes have two- and three-bedroom floor plans of about 1,400 to 2,000 square feet, with 9-foot ceilings, open-plan kitchens with quartz countertops and solid wood shaker cabinets, and private enclosed yards with a gas outlet.
The townhomes and condos share strata plan EPS1140. Check the current fees, bylaws and minutes before you write an offer.
Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)
Interiors & Finishes

The Heights townhomes were designed with open-plan kitchens, quartz countertops, designer backsplashes, a stainless steel double sink, Energy Star appliances and solid wood shaker cabinets. Nine-foot ceilings and oversized windows bring in plenty of light.
Ensuites have glass-enclosed showers, quartz countertops and deep soaker tubs. Each townhome has a private, enclosed yard with a gas outlet.
Location & Walkability
The Shops at Morgan Crossing are about 0.7 km from The Heights, and Grandview Corners, with Home Depot and Walmart, is about 1 km away.

Sunnyside Park, Oliver Park, and Morgan Creek Park are all within easy reach, making this a strong location for families, dog owners, and outdoor enthusiasts. Highway 99 is minutes away for commuters heading to Vancouver, Richmond, or the US border.

Buyer FAQs
What is the price range for The Heights townhomes?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent The Heights sales and current listings.
How many bedrooms do The Heights townhomes have?
The Heights townhomes have two- and three-bedroom floor plans of about 1,400 to 2,000 square feet. The community also includes 66 condos in a separate building.
When was The Heights built?
The Heights was built by Lakewood. Sources give different completion years, so check the year built on the listing for any unit you're considering.
Does The Heights allow pets?

Pet policies at The Heights are governed by the strata corporation and typically permit pets with reasonable restrictions on type and size. Always confirm current pet bylaws directly with strata management before purchasing, particularly if you have larger dogs or multiple animals.
Does The Heights allow rentals?

Under BC's Strata Property Act amendments effective November 24, 2022, residential strata corporations cannot restrict long-term rentals, so townhomes at The Heights can be rented long term. Short-term rentals (such as Airbnb or VRBO) remain subject to strata bylaws and municipal licensing. Buyers should review the current strata bylaws, Form B, and recent strata minutes before purchasing.
What schools are near The Heights in South Surrey?

The Heights is in the Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Southridge School, an independent K-12 school, is at 2656 160 Street.
How does The Heights compare to other Grandview Surrey townhome communities?
The Heights stands out for its private yards and its location near Morgan Crossing. Jared can walk you through a side-by-side comparison of current Grandview Surrey options.
